g.text: ESP32 AUTOMATED WATER LEVEL MONITORING SYSTEM
Complete Hardware Wiring Schematic • 12V Solenoid • 12V Diaphragm Pump • LM2596 • 4-Ch Relay • Analog Depth Sensor
Buck VOUT+ ➔ ESP32 Vin & Relay VCC
1. Adjust LM2596 buck converter to EXACTLY 5.0V BEFORE connecting ESP32 • 2. Solder flyback diodes (1N4007) across Solenoid and Pump • 3. Keep all grounds unified.
